integrity: Finite computational checks are independent corroboration of enumerated cases, not a substitute for the infinite-family proof; public source claims are attributed; no independent scientific audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite real unit-edge cocktail-party metrics for integers m>=3; full classifying facet criterion and raw total 4^m-2m-2 already known from 2018 complete multipartite theorem. New claim concerns evaluated facet incidence statistics, asymptotics, and natural orbit distribution. Equivalence to an unindexed result cannot be ruled out.
title: Chi-square facet-incidence fluctuations in cocktail-party Lipschitz-free balls
